findings.issue: DATA implied-DO statement entities had no exact plan
findings.resolution: outer INTEGER :: i = 99 with DATA (a(i), i=1,3) /10,20,30/ gives a == [10,20,30] and i == 99

findings.issue: statement-entity type plans checked only values, not kind
findings.resolution: exact KIND checks for implicit and integer-type-spec statement entities

findings.issue: reopened: IMPLICIT INTEGER(KIND=k2) followed a declaration of k2 in the same scoping unit
findings.resolution: k2 obtained by USE before IMPLICIT

findings.issue: reopened: a possibly-unsupported kind cannot be guarded at run time once it appears in a declaration
findings.resolution: k2 = SELECTED_INT_KIND(18), guaranteed to exist by 7.4.3.1 p2; distinct-kind rows selected by the two_integer_kinds profile and skipped when k2 == KIND(0)
